# Contributing

Issues and questions are welcome.

Pull requests are read but may not be merged: this is a personal, experimental project.
Open an issue before a large change, and run the checks under "Validate this checkout"
in the README.

Some files are shared with the other Warmboot edition and kept identical by the
maintainer.

Contributions are accepted under the MIT licence.

AI-assisted contributions are fine if you have the right to submit them and have checked
them.

Be respectful. The maintainer may close or lock a thread.

No support is promised.
